card.name: Drug interaction wording before effects
card.fires_on: The word "the" right after verbs like antagonize, potentiate or enhance in drug-interaction sentences. It also fires partway through interacting drug names such as reserpine, diltiazem, buspirone and CYP3A.

modes.label: "the" after interaction verb
modes.description: The word "the" after antagonize, potentiate or potentiated, just before a named effect.
modes.example: Ziprasidone may antagonize<< the>> effects of levodopa and dopamine agon

modes.label: Inside interacting drug names
modes.description: Partway through the name of a drug or enzyme named as an interacting agent.
modes.example: Enhanced effects and increased toxicity of buspirone may be possible during concomitant administration with dilt<<iaz>>em.

card.writes: It slightly pushes away from words about neurons and nerve firing, with no clear positive output.
card.plain: It marks spots in drug-interaction text where one drug's effect on another is about to be described.
